forensic_note: Native pendingStop can be replaced before its availableAt when bars publish end+1s, delaying intraday updates. NATIVE72 and FAST24 preserve this existing implementation; new PROTECT48/RUNNER72 use pending queues so an older received stop is not lost. This is a documented component difference, not an unreported baseline fix.
